names.name: search_workspace
names.description: Search authorized Plane object references across workspace types; this is not work-item search.

names.name: search_catalog
names.description: Search the complete supported operation catalog without granting execution permission.

names.name: describe_operation
names.description: Describe one exact major-version operation contract and its curated overlay.

names.name: compose_typescript
names.description: Run bounded model-written TypeScript through credential-free host callbacks.

names.name: search_work_items
names.description: Search authorized work items by text, sequence, or project identifier; it does not search all workspace object types.

names.name: get_work_item
names.description: Read one authorized work item and its bounded visible relations.

names.name: create_work_item
names.description: Create one authorized parent or child work item with optional cycle placement.

names.name: update_work_item
names.description: Update authorized work-item fields or cycle placement.

names.name: create_comment
names.description: Create one sanitized source-linked comment under current Plane authorization.
